## Summary
I am a Senior Cloud Consultant specializing in IT infrastructure architecture, Cloud-Native Engineering, and DevOps. I help enterprise customers migrate from traditional IT structures to agile, containerized platforms. My deep expertise lies in automation (RHEL, Ansible) and GitOpsifying OpenShift environments.
